checks.name: naming-conventions
checks.description: Verify that file and variable names follow naming conventions
checks.rule:
Check that:
- TypeScript/JavaScript files use camelCase or kebab-case
- Class names use PascalCase
- Constants use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
- Functions and variables use camelCase
- Interface names start with 'I' prefix or use PascalCase
- Private members start with underscore or use # syntax

checks.name: deleted-code-blocks
checks.description: Detect large blocks of deleted code that might indicate important functionality removal
checks.rule:
Identify deletions of:
- More than 50 consecutive lines
- Entire functions or classes
- Critical business logic
- Flag if deletion lacks corresponding additions or refactoring

checks.name: console-log-check
checks.description: Detect console.log statements that should not be committed
checks.rule: Flag any new console.log, console.debug, or console.error statements added to the codebase unless they are in test files or specific logging utilities

checks.name: hardcoded-credentials
checks.description: Check for hardcoded credentials, API keys, or sensitive data
checks.rule:
Detect patterns like:
- API keys or tokens in plain text
- Passwords or secrets
- Database connection strings with credentials
- Private keys or certificates

checks.name: missing-error-handling
checks.description: Ensure async operations have proper error handling
checks.rule:
Check that:
- Async functions have try-catch blocks or .catch() handlers
- Promise chains include error handling
- Database operations handle failures gracefully

checks.name: todo-comments
checks.description: Flag TODO comments that might need attention before merge
checks.rule: Identify TODO, FIXME, HACK, or XXX comments and report them for review

checks.name: code-duplication
checks.rule: Look for similar code blocks that could be refactored into shared functions or utilities

checks.name: missing-tests
checks.description: Check if new features include corresponding test files
checks.rule: If new source files are added (not in test directories), verify that corresponding test files exist or are being added in this PR
